$keepImages: Art we own, so it survives the strip with its src rewritten. The four suit glyphs are hand-authored (commit 4efb68f) and already served here for the game landing; they also carry meaning in the text — in Ch10's belt slots and App D's district lines the glyph is the ONLY label, so stripping them left `- : First belt slot`. Their inline height:1em/vertical-align comes from the vault markup and survives with the tag; they draw in currentColor, and dark mode inverts .reference-body img.
$hoistPin: Audited every shipping sidebar against where it lands, 2026-08-08. Only the wrong ones are listed; the rest sit correctly under the section they trail. Three groups: (a) it belongs to the entry it PRECEDES, because the book prints it in the margin at the foot of the previous column — the imp/nymph desire tables, 'Why tarot?', and 'Learning the Challenge Phase' (which otherwise pins to '5. End the round', the last step of the very sequence it introduces); (b) it belongs to an ANCESTOR of the heading it fell on, because it discusses a whole section while trailing one item of it — 'Effect names' and 'Not just for Challenges' land on the single effect 'Trip', 'Sorcery' on the talent 'Dwimmercraft', 'Negative bonds' on the single bond 'Ward', 'Lyric incantations' on the Lich's 'Body', 'Initiative strategies' on 'Step 3', 'The pace of travel' on the Camp Phase's last step; (c) 'Anything that's not nailed down' is general advice on borrowing material that fell on '21. Well', an arbitrary dungeon seed. Left alone as genuinely ambiguous, your call: 'The gates' (about the outer ring, sits between the central power and the core districts — neither owns it), 'Morale' (on the Wands action 'Banter', which may well be right), 'A reminder' in ch5 (about attribute priority generally, sits between two Paths). Round two (2026-08-08, Chris's review of the click-through): ten more retargeted by eye against the book — mostly sidebars that had attached to one item of a section rather than the section, or to a step in a flow summary. Where a target text occurs twice in a note the shallowest wins, which is what makes '2. Break bread' resolve to the section rather than to its line in the Flow of the Camp Phase. The untitled ch9 upkeep one turned out not to be a sidebar at all and was fixed in the vault text. Everything from 'Gear tiers' on is still unreviewed. Round three finished the list: the six statblock-anatomy notes (Health/Defense, Notes, Lesser/Greater dooms, Attributes, Likes and Hates) all belong to Creature Stats rather than to the first field they happened to trail, and 'What is an “animal”?' is printed in two margins so the vault holds it twice, byte-identical — identical pinned blocks are placed once. All 84 sidebars are now reviewed.

$textReplacements: The book prints the four tarot suits as pip icons; the vault stores them as the literal words SWORDS / DISKS / CUPS / BATONS, right beside the suit's own name. On the page that read as a stutter — "SWORDS **Swords:**" — and for Pentacles it named the same suit twice under two different names ("DISKS **Pentacles:**"). The word does the job the icon does in print, so the token just goes; the pack ships suit-*.svg if these ever want to be real pips. Trailing/leading space is folded into the pattern so no double space is left behind. The vault is shared with other importers and read-only, which is why this lives here.
